title: 第19章 再会美女柳如风第20章 多嘴的药材店老板
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 刷！
练了十几遍的郑元满意地把长剑收了回来。
虽然还不能运用自如，发挥最大的威力，但已经把错误都纠正过来了。
这套剑诀还真是神奇，有至刚至阳之意，还有料敌于先之意。
“哥，该吃饭了，快擦擦你头上的汗水。”
小妹郑萱拿着毛巾走了过来，哥哥从小就勤学苦练，而且马上就要三族大比了。
郑萱早就出来了，不过怕打扰哥哥郑元练功，在一旁静静地看着。
“嗯，小妹，你也应该努力修炼，现在还是淬体六层修为，族里的兄弟姐妹都是淬体七层，八层修为了。”
小妹冰雪聪明，只不过平日里太贪玩了，修炼更是马马虎虎，所以那天才会被王远滕欺负。
自己总有一天会走出浩城，不在她身边。
郑萱自然不知道哥哥郑元体内阳气过盛，需要造化纯阴之女化解。
反而是一把抱住了郑元的胳膊：“反正有哥你保护我，还有修炼太枯燥无聊了。”
“你啊，一点不求上进。”
郑元气的揉了一下小妹的秀发，一副恨铁不成钢的表情。
“讨厌了，哥你把我精心梳理的头发都弄乱了，还有你怎么比娘还能墨迹了……”
“瞎说，我是男人，怎么能和娘比，欠打……”
郑元气的挥起了手，当然最后还是被小妹打的落荒而逃了。
吃过早饭，郑萱又凑到了哥哥郑元身旁了。
“哥，今天你带我上街去买只玉灵兔好不好？”
族里要好的小姐妹们都有了兽宠，唯独自己没有呢。
当然一只玉灵兔价值不菲，但哥哥不是有灵石了嘛。
“败家啊，那玉灵兔起码要卖一百块下品灵石，十万大山里多的是，哪天我给你抓一只多好。”
虽然有了灵石但也不能乱花钱，抓一个多好。
哪天上山给小妹抓一只，何况今天自己还有事呢，那就是去见那个泼辣的俏寡妇柳如风。
“那哥你这次一定不能失言，咱们拉勾。”
郑萱伸出了小拇指，一脸认真。
“好，哥答应你。”
郑元笑着伸出了小拇指。
郑元顺着大街七转八拐，很快就来到一个镖局的前面，和门口守卫告诉了一声。
“原来是郑公子，我家镖头吩咐过了，你直接进去就行了。”

brush!
Zheng Yuan, who had practiced it more than a dozen times, took the sword back with satisfaction.
Although I still can't use it freely and exert its maximum power, I have corrected all the mistakes.
This set of sword tactics is really magical, it has the meaning of being extremely strong and the sun, and it also has the meaning of predicting the enemy first.
"Brother, it's time to eat. Quickly wipe the sweat from your head."
The younger sister Zheng Xuan came over with a towel. Her elder brother had been studying and practicing hard since he was a child, and there was going to be a competition between the three clans soon.
Zheng Xuan had already come out, but she was afraid of disturbing her brother Zheng Yuan's practice, so she watched quietly from the side.
"Well, little sister, you should also practice hard. You are still at the sixth level of Body Tempering. The brothers and sisters in the clan are all at the seventh and eighth levels of Body Tempering."
The younger sister Bingxue is smart, but she is too playful on weekdays, and her training is even more so-so, so she was bullied by Wang Yuanteng that day.
One day he will leave Haocheng and no longer be by her side.
Naturally, Zheng Xuan didn't know that her brother Zheng Yuan's body had too much yang energy and needed a woman who created pure yin to resolve it.
Instead, he hugged Zheng Yuan's arm and said, "Anyway, I have you to protect me, brother, and training is too boring."
"You don't want to make progress at all."
Zheng Yuan rubbed the little girl's hair angrily, with an expression of hatred for steel.
"I hate it. Brother, you have messed up my carefully combed hair. And why are you better at ink stains than my mother..."
"Nonsense, I am a man, how can I compare with my mother? I deserve a beating..."
Zheng Yuan waved his hand angrily, but of course he was beaten up by the younger sister and ran away.
After breakfast, Zheng Xuan came next to her brother Zheng Yuan again.
"Brother, can you take me to the street to buy a Jade Spirit Rabbit today?"
The best sisters in the clan all have animal pets, but I don’t have one.
Of course, a Jade Spirit Rabbit is worth a lot of money, but doesn’t my brother already have a spirit stone?
"You're a prodigal. That Jade Spirit Rabbit costs at least a hundred yuan of low-grade spiritual stones. There are plenty of them in the Hundred Thousand Mountains. I'd like to catch one for you one day."
Although you have spiritual stones, you can't spend money randomly. It would be great to catch one.
One day I will go up the mountain to catch one for my little sister, not to mention that I have something else to do today, which is to meet that shrewd and pretty widow Liu Rufeng.
"Brother, you must not make a mistake this time, let's play hookup."
Zheng Xuan held out her little finger with a serious look on her face.
"Okay, I promise you."
Zheng Yuan smiled and held out his little finger.
…
Zheng Yuan walked along the street and soon came to an escort agency and told the guard at the door.
"It turns out to be Mr. Zheng. My bodyguard has given orders. You can just go in."
